contentHtml:
Discover the dynamic landscape of the UAE at your own pace. Plan an exciting road trip in UAE to embrace its cultural heritage. The UAE’s natural environment is a major attraction that will never cease to amaze you. Driving through the rugged mountains and diverse extended deserts is easier with a rental car.

If you have not seen the beauty and serenity of the Middle East’s third-largest economy, get ready for this memorable adventure. Don’t own a car? No problem, as the rental car companies offer the best vehicles for an exhilarating ride. Every mile you pass, experience comfort and the flexibility of transition. Every mile into a memorable experience.

The well-designed roads invite you to a seamless ride. The residents of the UAE leverage the facility of rental cars for their trips. Tourists can also enjoy the freedom of travelling by renting a car in the UAE. This is your time to create lifetime memories and avail yourself of the chance to explore the hidden gems of the Emirate. Have a look at the list of the exhilarating top 10 destinations for a road trip in UAE by car rental. Add these attractions to your list and get ready for your journey.

Why Explore the Road Trips in UAE by Car?

The guided tours limit the adventure to restricted locations and time-conscious management. This is where renting a car appears to be a convenient, affordable, and flexible option. You no longer have to wait for public transportation and let others invade your personal space. Relying on such a travelling medium keeps you away from discovering the underrated yet serene places. Take your time and make your travel schedule. Within privacy, your road trip in the UAE is sure to give you an unforgettable experience.

Top 10 Road Trip Destinations in UAE

The UAE covers the most captivating and intriguing stations in the world. From the grand desert dunes to the peaceful coastal landscapes, driving gives you the chance to explore these miracles at your leisure. Driving on rent has become reasonable with suitable packages. Find these appealing spots on your way and make the UAE road trip an experience of a lifetime.

1. Jebel Jais, Ras Al Khaimah

Get ready to satisfy your adventurous spirit and adrenaline rush with the fun escapes that the Jebel Jais has in store for you. The towering mountains of this city are the highest peaks of the UAE. The perfect spot for thrill seekers, the adventurous park offering ziplining and hiking trails will give you a lifetime experience. The serene views along the drive make your trip unforgettable. 

2. Hatta

Hatta is a calm escape surrounded by tall mountains. It is located near the Oman border. Encompassing all the greenery, this spot is perfect for nature lovers. Rent a kayak at Hatta Dam, visit the Heritage Village, or explore the mountain biking trails. The drive to this place adds more scenic views to your photo album.

3. Liwa Oasis, Abu Dhabi

A visit to Liwa Oasis will take you to the majestic Rub al Khali, the Empty Quarter. It is the largest continuous sand desert in the world. The golden dunes and vast extended landscapes make this destination a photographer’s paradise. For a trouble-free drive, a rental four-wheel-drive vehicle is recommended.

4. Fujairah’s Coastal Drive

Driving through Fujairah enables you to enjoy the beauty of the eastern coastline. Stop at Al Aqah Beach for snorkeling or visit the Fujairah Fort for a slice of history. The coastal roads offer mesmerizing views of the Arabian Sea, making it an ideal UAE road trip destination.

5. Al Ain

AL Ain is all about pushing oasis, thus known as the “Garden City of the UAE”. Drive to Jebel Hafeet for spectacular views or visit Al Ain Zoo. Relax at the natural hot springs in Green Mubazzarah. This haven of culture and nature makes your weekend getaway worthwhile.

6. Dubai to Abu Dhabi

The Dubai-to-Abu Dhabi road trip is itself a memorable route. Along the way, stop by the Dubai Parks and Resorts. Explore the Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque. Other than this, you can enjoy thrilling rides at Ferrari World. The smooth highway makes the drive both hassle-free and relaxing.

7. Sir Bani Yas Island

If you have never experienced the thrill of mountain biking surrounded by the lavish green, this fascinating island must be added to your list. The ferries are available for the drive with the appealing views. The luxurious accommodation adds more to the adventure. On the island, you can have wildlife safaris and go kayaking.

8. Khor Fakkan

Khor Fakkan, located on the east coast, is a hidden gem that offers pristine beaches and lush landscapes. The drive takes you through mountain tunnels and beautiful coastal views. Visit its Amphitheatre and Waterfall for a mix of culture and nature.

9. Kalba

This enchanting town is famous for its mangroves, serene beaches, and nature reserves. Its wildlife sanctuary is irresistibly stunning to visit for birdwatchers and nature enthusiasts. The tranquil environment calms your mood.

10. Sharjah’s Cultural Tour

Opening the traditional door of art and culture, Sharjah takes you back to the treasure of history. Start at the Museum of Islamic Civilization, visit the Art Foundation, and explore the Heart of Sharjah area. The city’s cultural richness provides a refreshing contrast to the UAE’s modern architecture.

Tips for a Successful Road Trip in UAE

  • Plan the route of your trip with the help of GPS or maps. You can spot the restrooms along the way as well.
  • Choose a car for rent that matches your needs or demands. For instance, an SUV is suitable for desert trips and a sedan for city drives.
  • The UAE’s weather is usually warm. So, stay hydrated and carry plenty of water, especially during long trips.
  • Ensure your tank is full before heading to remote areas like Liwa Oasis.
  • Include snacks, sunscreen, and emergency supplies for a smooth journey.

Benefits of Renting a Car for a Road Trip

Renting a car for your road trip in the UAE saves you from paying additional charges for expensive taxi rides. Renting is a cost-effective solution that immediately solves the problem of transport. Along with this, you have the option to choose a vehicle of your choice from the wider diversity. 

Moreover, with a rental car, you can explore off-the-beaten-path destinations and create your flexible route. Larger vehicles like SUVs work ideally for families for comfortable travel. Along with it, ample space for storage purposes is available. If you are travelling solo, you can opt for compact cars that are also budget-friendly.  

Another notable benefit is the ability to travel beyond major cities. Such a transition is usually not possible with public transportation. Equipped with modern amenities like GPS navigation, it will be easier for you to discover new paths. Car rentals improve the travel experience with fuel-efficient options as well.

FAQs: Road trip destinations in UAE

Q1. What are popular road trip routes in the UAE?

The popular road trips that you should look forward to are Dubai to Hatta, Abu Dhabi to Liwa, and Ras Al Khaimah’s mountains.

Q2. How far apart are major stops on UAE road trips?

Most major destinations in the UAE are 1–3 hours apart from each other. This makes it easy to cover more than one place in a single day.

Q3. What preparations should I make before a long road trip (car, fuel, permits)?

Check the car condition, fill fuel, carry ID, and know the route.

Q4. Are there good rest stops and services along the routes?

Yes, petrol stations and cafes are common.

Q5. What is the best time of day or year for road trips in the UAE?

Winter mornings are ideal for cooler weather and clear views.

Q6. What safety tips should I know for driving in remote areas?

Carry water, a GPS, and ensure mobile coverage before heading out.
